# Service and delivery capacity

## Service security

| Services | Public caliber of the official network | Use boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Service level | Provide full SLA | Specific indicators, measurement methods and compensation mechanisms are based on products purchased and contracts |
| Exclusive support | Provision of 1V1 exclusive services | Service content and staffing are aligned to project programmes |
| Service period | 7x24 hours of service provided | Specific response indicators and measurements are based on products and contracts purchased |

## Delivery process

| Service stage | Main elements | Border |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pre-sale counselling | Understanding client business landscape, product range, system environment and security needs | Specific programme needs confirmation |
| Programme and deployment | Identification of product versions, deployment modalities, data and system interfaces according to project scope | Deliveries, cycles, personnel and costs are based on recognized project programmes |
| Access and training | Support system access, operational training and necessary use guidance | Target, format, frequency and materials of training based on project engagement |
| Transport security | Provision of acceptance, trouble management and use support during the period of service contracted | Response time, service time and promotion mechanism based on contract or service level agreement |
| Ongoing operations | Optimization of functions, processes or configurations in relation to actual usage | Inclusion of ongoing operations depends on the range of services purchased |

## Privatization protection

| Information Item | Standard calibration |
| --- | --- |
| Protection policy | The duration of the insurance coverage, the renewal fee criteria, the time period of service and the level of response for the privatized project are based on the quotation, contract or service level agreement |
| External borders | The ratio of the insurance cycle to the continuation fee that is not specified in the contract is not included as a common commitment |
